transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Week 1). A novel respiratory virus has been confirmed in three US cities, with likely undetected spread. Early case reports are alarming but the sample is tiny and biased toward the sickest. You do not yet know the true infection-fatality rate or how transmissible it is. Hospitals in the affected cities report rising admissions. Markets fell 4% on the news. The WHO has called an emergency meeting.

Your health agencies want aggressive early action 'to be safe'; your economic team warns that shutting down on a maybe could be its own catastrophe; governors are looking to you for a lead but guard their authority. Every option has a cost, and you must choose before the data is in. What do you do?

actions.name: surge_testing

params.rationale: We cannot size any response correctly without knowing the true IFR and transmission rate; genomic sequencing and rapid case-finding in all three cities is the essential foundation for every decision that follows.

actions.rationale: We cannot size any response correctly without knowing the true IFR and transmission rate; genomic sequencing and rapid case-finding in all three cities is the essential foundation for every decision that follows.

actions.name: travel_restrictions

params.rationale: Slowing importation of new seeding events from affected regions buys critical days for surveillance and supply build-up before community spread becomes nationwide.

actions.rationale: Slowing importation of new seeding events from affected regions buys critical days for surveillance and supply build-up before community spread becomes nationwide.

actions.name: invoke_dpa

params.rationale: PPE, diagnostic tests, and ventilator production lines take weeks to spin up; invoking the DPA now prevents the supply-chain crises that overwhelmed hospitals in past outbreaks.

actions.rationale: PPE, diagnostic tests, and ventilator production lines take weeks to spin up; invoking the DPA now prevents the supply-chain crises that overwhelmed hospitals in past outbreaks.

actions.name: candid_briefings

params.rationale: Transparent, data-driven daily communication prevents panic-driven rumors, builds the public trust needed for future behavioral asks, and signals government competence to markets and allies.

actions.rationale: Transparent, data-driven daily communication prevents panic-driven rumors, builds the public trust needed for future behavioral asks, and signals government competence to markets and allies.

actions.name: consult_congress

params.rationale: Pre-positioning Congress on emergency authority and funding now means relief legislation can move in days rather than weeks when — and if — the crisis deepens.

actions.rationale: Pre-positioning Congress on emergency authority and funding now means relief legislation can move in days rather than weeks when — and if — the crisis deepens.

actions.name: fund_vaccine

params.rationale: Launching a crash public-private vaccine and therapeutics program immediately compresses the timeline to medical countermeasures, which is ultimately the only durable exit from a pandemic.

actions.rationale: Launching a crash public-private vaccine and therapeutics program immediately compresses the timeline to medical countermeasures, which is ultimately the only durable exit from a pandemic.

transcript.narrative: Testing and sequencing capacity expands; the picture sharpens.

transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Week 2). Estimated infection index 1.3 (was 1.0 at week 1). Deaths to date: 0.
Economy index 99/100. Public trust 58/100. Hospital strain 2/100. Restriction level 0.5/10.
Vaccine/therapeutics progress: 26/100.
ASSESSMENT (LOW confidence): data remain too thin to pin down severity; estimates span from 'bad flu' to 'catastrophic.'

actions.name: mask_mandate

params.rationale: Masking is a low-cost, high-impact intervention that reduces transmission regardless of final severity estimates, and acting now while the infection index is still manageable is far cheaper than acting after exponential growth takes hold.

actions.rationale: Masking is a low-cost, high-impact intervention that reduces transmission regardless of final severity estimates, and acting now while the infection index is still manageable is far cheaper than acting after exponential growth takes hold.

actions.name: protect_vulnerable

params.rationale: With zero deaths but rising spread and an unknown IFR, shielding the elderly and high-risk populations now is the highest expected-value targeted intervention — it caps the worst-case mortality outcome while keeping society more functional than a broad shutdown.

actions.rationale: With zero deaths but rising spread and an unknown IFR, shielding the elderly and high-risk populations now is the highest expected-value targeted intervention — it caps the worst-case mortality outcome while keeping society more functional than a broad shutdown.

actions.name: defer_to_states

params.rationale: Governors have local authority and on-the-ground intelligence; the federal role right now is to flood them with data, supplies from the DPA, and clear guidance — not to override them before severity is confirmed.

actions.rationale: Governors have local authority and on-the-ground intelligence; the federal role right now is to flood them with data, supplies from the DPA, and clear guidance — not to override them before severity is confirmed.

actions.name: candid_briefings

params.rationale: Public trust at 58/100 is dangerously low for a crisis that will require sustained behavioral compliance — consistent, honest briefings are the cheapest trust-building tool available.

actions.rationale: Public trust at 58/100 is dangerously low for a crisis that will require sustained behavioral compliance — consistent, honest briefings are the cheapest trust-building tool available.

actions.name: economic_relief

params.rationale: The economy is at 99/100 now, which is precisely the right moment to architect relief legislation with Congress — passing it before crisis hits means households and businesses get support in days, not months, when strain arrives.

actions.rationale: The economy is at 99/100 now, which is precisely the right moment to architect relief legislation with Congress — passing it before crisis hits means households and businesses get support in days, not months, when strain arrives.

transcript.sitrep:
DEVELOPMENT: A cluster at a packed event seeds cases in a dozen new states. Pressure to act -- or to stop overreacting -- is intense from all sides.

SITUATION (Week 3). Estimated infection index 1.7 (was 1.0 at week 1). Deaths to date: 0.
Economy index 101/100. Public trust 61/100. Hospital strain 2/100. Restriction level 1.0/10.
Vaccine/therapeutics progress: 46/100.
ASSESSMENT (LOW confidence): data remain too thin to pin down severity; estimates span from 'bad flu' to 'catastrophic.'

actions.name: federal_lockdown_guidance

params.rationale: The infection index has jumped to 1.7 with confirmed multi-state seeding — deaths are a lagging indicator by 2-4 weeks, meaning the zero-death figure reflects last month's tiny case counts, not today's national spread; acting now is the only way to stay ahead of the exponential curve.

actions.rationale: The infection index has jumped to 1.7 with confirmed multi-state seeding — deaths are a lagging indicator by 2-4 weeks, meaning the zero-death figure reflects last month's tiny case counts, not today's national spread; acting now is the only way to stay ahead of the exponential curve.

actions.name: surge_testing

params.rationale: Rapid expansion of testing into the dozen newly seeded states is urgent to determine whether we are seeing true community transmission or containable clusters, and to finally pin down severity estimates before hospital strain escalates.

actions.rationale: Rapid expansion of testing into the dozen newly seeded states is urgent to determine whether we are seeing true community transmission or containable clusters, and to finally pin down severity estimates before hospital strain escalates.

actions.name: candid_briefings

params.rationale: Public trust is only 61 and compliance with lockdown guidance depends entirely on the public understanding the lagging-indicator logic — why we must act before deaths confirm severity.

actions.rationale: Public trust is only 61 and compliance with lockdown guidance depends entirely on the public understanding the lagging-indicator logic — why we must act before deaths confirm severity.

SITUATION (Week 4). Estimated infection index 2.2 (was 1.0 at week 1). Deaths to date: 0.
Economy index 101/100. Public trust 64/100. Hospital strain 3/100. Restriction level 2.8/10.
Vaccine/therapeutics progress: 66/100.
ASSESSMENT (HIGH confidence): the pathogen is comparable to a severe seasonal flu; transmissibility is moderate.

actions.name: protect_vulnerable

params.rationale: With HIGH confidence that this is severe-flu-equivalent, the core strategy should now concentrate resources on the elderly and high-risk — the population that drives hospitalization and mortality in flu-like illness — rather than broad population-wide restrictions.

actions.rationale: With HIGH confidence that this is severe-flu-equivalent, the core strategy should now concentrate resources on the elderly and high-risk — the population that drives hospitalization and mortality in flu-like illness — rather than broad population-wide restrictions.

actions.name: defer_to_states

params.rationale: Now that severity is confirmed as flu-comparable, blanket federal lockdown guidance is disproportionate; governors are better positioned to calibrate local restrictions to local hospital strain and demographics, with federal data and supply support.

actions.rationale: Now that severity is confirmed as flu-comparable, blanket federal lockdown guidance is disproportionate; governors are better positioned to calibrate local restrictions to local hospital strain and demographics, with federal data and supply support.

actions.name: candid_briefings

params.rationale: Public trust requires honestly communicating that the data resolved toward severe-flu severity and that we are proportionately recalibrating — this demonstrates evidence-based governance and will reward the public's patience with transparency.

actions.rationale: Public trust requires honestly communicating that the data resolved toward severe-flu severity and that we are proportionately recalibrating — this demonstrates evidence-based governance and will reward the public's patience with transparency.
